problemSigns.detail: One side of your garage door sits lower than the other in the opening. This indicates a broken or frayed lift cable on one side.
You see a cable hanging loose from the side of the door. Or it is wrapped incorrectly around the cable drum above the opening.
The door makes a harsh grinding or scraping sound when it moves. This can mean a cable is rubbing incorrectly or is about to fail.
Your garage door closes much faster than normal, or drops suddenly. This is a serious safety concern and indicates a cable problem.

After repair, we perform a balance test on the garage door. We also test the safety-reverse mechanism. This ensures safe operation.
We confirm the repair is complete and the door operates smoothly and safely. We confirm the new cables are correctly installed.
